card.name: Inside antipsychotic, opioid, corticosteroid words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of long drug-class words such as antips-ych-otic, O-pi-oid and cortic-oster-oid, mostly in switching or conversion instructions. It also fires once on the word general before anesthesia.

modes.label: Antipsychotic class word
modes.description: The "ych" piece inside antipsychotic(s), just before the ending.
modes.example: When switching patients currently at steady-state on a long-acting injectable antips<<ych>>otic, initiate INVEGA SUST

modes.label: Opioid class word
modes.description: The "pi" piece inside opioid after O.
modes.example: Conversion from Other Oral O<<pi>>oid Analgesics to Oxymor

modes.label: Corticosteroid class word
modes.description: The middle piece of corticosteroid in a switch-to-injection instruction.
modes.example: unable to take oral medications to parenteral cortic<<oster>>oid formulations without delay
